data.body_html:
Planning a family day on the water in Marbella? Combine a private boat charter with a jetski, snorkel gear, and a paddleboard for a full day of fun. Departing from Puerto Banús, our family-friendly fleet includes the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) at Tier A pricing from €749/2h, or the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) with a free jetski from €4,719/4h. Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and IVA. Book your 2029 date now via WhatsApp.

This page covers everything you need to know: boat options, pricing, inclusions, the best snorkelling spots, and how to book. Let's dive in.

Why choose a family boat day with jetski, snorkel, and paddleboard?

A private boat charter gives your family total freedom. No crowded tour boats, no fixed itineraries. You decide where to go, how long to stay, and what to do. The jetski adds adrenaline for teens and adults; snorkel gear lets kids explore underwater life; the paddleboard offers a calm way to cruise the coastline. All equipment is provided at no extra cost (jetski included free on Tier B boats).

Marbella's coastline is ideal for families. Calm coves like Cala del Faro and Cala Cortés have shallow, clear water perfect for snorkelling and paddleboarding. The average sea temperature from June to October is 22–26°C, so no wetsuit needed.

Our family-friendly fleet

We operate from Puerto Banús with a range of boats suitable for families. For small to medium groups, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) offer a spacious cockpit, sun pads, and a shaded flybridge. Both are easy to board from the water, making them great for kids.

For larger families or multi-family groups, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) or its grey variant (24m, 12 pax) provide a huge sundeck, a jet ski included free, and a professional crew. All boats have a cooler, Bluetooth speakers, and a freshwater shower.

View the full fleet on our Marbella boat rental hub.

All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden fees.

What's included in your family boat charter

  • Licensed English-speaking skipper
  • Fuel for the full duration
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (chips, olives, nuts)
  • Snorkel masks and fins (adult and child sizes)
  • Paddleboard (inflatable, easy to store)
  • Jetski (free on Mangusta 80; add-on for Tier A boats)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%)

You may bring your own food and drinks. The boat has a cooler and ice. If you want a catered lunch, let us know at least 48 hours in advance.

Best snorkelling and paddleboarding spots near Marbella

Our skippers know the best spots based on wind and sea conditions. Popular family-friendly locations include:

  • Cala del Faro – Sheltered cove with rocky reefs, 20 minutes from Puerto Banús.
  • Cala Cortés – Sandy beach with calm water, ideal for paddleboarding.
  • Río Verde – Shallow estuary where kids can see fish and crabs.
  • Cabopino – Nature reserve with dunes and clear water, 15 minutes east.
  • Estepona coast – Quieter coves with fewer boats, 30 minutes west.

Your skipper will adjust the itinerary based on your preferences. Typical family day: 2 hours cruising, 1 hour jetski, 1 hour snorkelling, 1 hour paddleboarding, plus lunch and swimming stops.

How to book your Marbella family boat day for 2029

Bookings are handled via WhatsApp for speed and flexibility. Here's the process:

  1. Message us with your preferred date, boat size, and number of guests.
  2. We confirm availability and send a payment link (50% deposit).
  3. Balance due 7 days before departure.
  4. Receive a confirmation with meeting point (Puerto Banús, Gate 5) and skipper contact.

For 2029, we recommend booking at least 2 months in advance for peak season (July–August). Weekdays are generally more available than weekends.

Contact us via WhatsApp to start planning your family adventure.
